neighbours.label: The kanji 奨 or 勧 in Japanese text (推奨, 奨励, 奨学金, 勧誘, 勧める, even in names), whatever it means; second, weaker trigger: a Chinese character typed right after a space that follows Latin letters or code (Peking 大学, # 录入). Synonyms without these characters (おすすめ, 推薦) and Chinese 奖 stay lower.
neighbours.short: the kanji 奨/勧 (spelling, not meaning)
neighbours.notes: Dense pole (30% of tokens reach 0.1 of max); plain Japanese idles near 0.30-0.40, so Japanese near misses are at risk of crossing 0.30. Test sentences written blind by a second author from the label only. Feeders: L28/N8853- and L32/N4095+ (byte-piece readers).
